description: Centralize all voice announcements to play ONLY from admin.html. This involves: (1) Adding TTS infrastructure to admin.html, (2) Modifying server.js to emit 'voice-announce' events to admin-room when announcements should play, (3) Replacing all speakAnnouncement() calls in agent.html and tl.html with socket.emit('voice-announce-request') calls to the server, (4) Having admin.html listen for 'voice-announce' and play them via the TTS system.
steps: Step 1 - Add TTS infrastructure to public/admin/index.html: Before the closing </script> tag (around line 2617), add the complete TTS system: _ttsQueue array, _ttsPlaying flag, _ttsReqCounter, _ttsPendingTurns map, socket listener for 'tts-turn-granted', _ttsRequestGlobalTurn() function, _ttsReleaseGlobalTurn() function, _ttsPlayNext() async function (uses Audio element pointing to /api/tts endpoint with speechSynthesis fallback), _splitTTS() function, and speakAnnouncement() function. Copy these from public/agent/index.html lines 3120-3195.

Step 2 - Add 'voice-announce' listener in admin.html: After the TTS infrastructure, add a socket.on('voice-announce', ({text}) => { speakAnnouncement(text); }); handler so admin plays any announcement the server sends.

Step 3 - Modify server.js to add a 'voice-announce-request' socket handler: In the io.on('connection') block (around line 2684), add a handler for 'voice-announce-request' that receives { text } and emits 'voice-announce' with { text } to 'admin-room'. This lets agent/TL panels request announcements without playing them locally.

Step 4 - Modify server.js to emit voice-announce for break events: In the break-start handler (line 2819), after the existing logic, emit io.to('admin-room').emit('voice-announce', { text: agentName + ' break par chale gaye hain.' }) using the agent's name from appState. Similarly for break-end (line 2820), emit that the agent returned from break. Use Hindi text matching the existing announcements.

Step 5 - Modify server.js to emit voice-announce for agent login: In the 'agent-start' handler (line 2721), after the agent is marked active, determine if the login is late (check if IST hour >= 10 or whatever the existing logic uses - look at agent.html login flow), then emit voice-announce to admin-room with the appropriate Hindi login announcement text including the agent's name and time.

Step 6 - In public/agent/index.html: Replace all speakAnnouncement() calls with socket.emit('voice-announce-request', { text: ... }) calls. This includes: (a) login announcement at line 1295-1297, (b) break started at line 1443, (c) break ended at line 1452, (d) break 5-min warning at line 1504, (e) break exceeded at line 1508. Keep the text exactly the same but emit to server instead of playing locally.

Step 7 - In public/tl/index.html: Same as Step 6 - Replace all speakAnnouncement() calls with socket.emit('voice-announce-request', { text: ... }) calls. This includes: (a) login announcement at line 2269-2271, (b) break started at line 2408, (c) break ended at line 2417, (d) break 5-min warning at line 2467, (e) break exceeded at line 2471.

Step 8 - Handle hourly review announcements: In agent.html (lines 3218-3340) and tl.html (lines 5295-5411), the announceDispositionStats() and announceTargetAndRanking() functions fetch data and build announcement text. These need to be changed to send the text to the server via socket.emit('voice-announce-request', { text }) instead of calling speakAnnouncement() locally. The functions still run on the agent/TL panels (they know their own agentId), but the audio output goes through admin.

Step 9 - Remove TTS infrastructure from agent.html and tl.html: Remove the _ttsQueue, _ttsPlaying, _ttsReqCounter, _ttsPendingTurns, tts-turn-granted listener, _ttsRequestGlobalTurn, _ttsReleaseGlobalTurn, _ttsPlayNext, _splitTTS, and speakAnnouncement function definitions from both panels. Keep the socket connection and other event listeners intact. The agent/TL panels no longer need these since they just emit requests to the server.

Step 10 - In server.js, update the 'voice-announce-request' handler to also participate in the TTS turn lock: Since the admin panel will now be the sole audio player, it will use the tts-request-turn/tts-turn-granted/tts-release-turn mechanism directly. The voice-announce-request handler on the server simply needs to relay to admin-room. No changes needed to the TTS lock mechanism itself since admin.html will use it directly.
acceptance_criteria: public/admin/index.html contains the complete TTS infrastructure (speakAnnouncement, _ttsQueue, _ttsPlayNext, etc.) and a socket.on('voice-announce') listener
public/agent/index.html has NO speakAnnouncement function definition and NO _ttsQueue/_ttsPlayNext infrastructure
public/tl/index.html has NO speakAnnouncement function definition and NO _ttsQueue/_ttsPlayNext infrastructure
All former speakAnnouncement() calls in agent.html and tl.html are replaced with socket.emit('voice-announce-request', { text: ... })
server.js has a 'voice-announce-request' socket handler that emits 'voice-announce' to 'admin-room'
The server starts without errors (npm start with a timeout)
verification: Run: node -c server.js (verify no syntax errors in server)

Run: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const html=fs.readFileSync('public/admin/index.html','utf8'); if(!html.includes('speakAnnouncement')) throw new Error('missing'); if(!html.includes('voice-announce')) throw new Error('missing listener'); console.log('admin OK')"
